item: 1. Duyên Hai wind farm · 1 = REE's Duyên Hải (V1-4) 48 MW; type; GEM Dong Hai V1-4
proposal: fix('VNM', 'Duyên Hai wind farm · 1', G, 'GEM 這筆的別名就是「Duyen Hai Wind Power Plant (V1-4)／NMĐ gió Duyên Hải (V1-4)」，狀態引用的西貢經濟時報 2025-09 報導的是 REE 子公司 Duyên Hải 風電公司在 Đông Hải 等三個社的 48 MW 電廠；業主 Asian Energy／Uniso 是 2018 年已被茶榮省終止的舊案。人民報：Duyên Hải（V1-4）10／10 部 2026-03-16 起全部正式運轉（券商摘要：2026-03-16 商轉）；KB 證券 2025 年第三季報告稱為離岸（潮間帶）專案、10 座離岸風機塔已裝完。改為運轉中、2026、離岸，業主改為 REE 的 Duyen Hai Wind Power JSC；機組數各來源不一（10 或 8 部），機型未查到', 'GEM’s own page gives this record’s other name as “Duyen Hai Wind Power Plant (V1-4) / NMĐ gió Duyên Hải (V1-4)”, and its status source (Saigon Times, Sep 2025) describes the 48 MW plant of REE’s subsidiary Duyen Hai Wind Power JSC in Dong Hai and two neighbouring communes; the listed owners Asian Energy / Uniso belong to an older project that Tra Vinh terminated in 2018. Nhan Dan: all 10 of 10 turbines of Duyen Hai (V1-4) in official operation from 16 Mar 2026 (a broker summary gives COD on 16 Mar 2026); KB Securities (3Q 2025) calls it an offshore (intertidal) project whose 10 offshore turbine towers were installed. Set to operating, 2026, offshore, owner REE’s Duyen Hai Wind Power JSC; the turbine count differs between sources (10 or 8) and the model was not found', 'https://nhandan.vn/post-952529.html', st=0, year=2026, type=1, owner='Duyen Hai Wind Power JSC (REE Corp)', note=True)
note_zh: GEM「Duyên Hai wind farm · 1」的別名寫明是 V1-4（NMĐ gió Duyên Hải (V1-4)），位置 Đông Hải；它的「施工中」引用的是 2025 年 REE 電廠的報導，但業主欄沿用 2018 年被茶榮省終止的 Asian Energy／Uniso 舊案（48.3 MW、21 部 2.3 MW 陸域）。REE 子公司 Duyên Hải 風電股份公司在 V1-4 位置建 48 MW（工商雜誌 2024），VIB 融資新聞寫在 Đông Hải、Long Thành、Ngũ Lạc 三社；人民報 2026-03：10／10 部 2026-03-16 起全部正式運轉；券商摘要（elibook）寫 2026-03-16 商轉；KB 證券寫離岸專案、10 座離岸風機塔裝完。所以這筆就是 REE 的 Duyên Hải（V1-4），2026 年全場運轉，型別依券商報告改離岸（潮間帶）。西貢經濟時報寫 8 部 6 MW，與人民報、KB 的 10 部不合，機組欄不寫。座標沒有可引用的出處（Overpass 連不上），保留 GEM 概略點。另：GEM「Dong Hai V1-4 Offshore wind farm」（50 MW、規劃）的越文名是「Đông Hải 1 Giai đoạn 4」，與金甌省 2026-08 動工的東海 1 號第 4 期（Miền Tây 風電公司、50 MW）同名同容量，不是 REE 這座；但它的座標在茶榮外海（來源是不能引用的 4C），值得另查。
note_en: GEM’s “Duyên Hai wind farm · 1” is named on its own page as V1-4 (NMĐ gió Duyên Hải (V1-4)) in Dong Hai; its “construction” status cites a 2025 report on REE’s plant, while the owner field carries the Asian Energy / Uniso project (48.3 MW, 21 × 2.3 MW onshore) that Tra Vinh terminated in 2018. REE’s subsidiary Duyen Hai Wind Power JSC built 48 MW at location V1-4 (Tap chi Cong Thuong, 2024), in Dong Hai, Long Thanh and Ngu Lac communes (VIB financing news); Nhan Dan (Mar 2026): all 10 of 10 turbines in official operation from 16 Mar 2026; a broker summary (elibook) gives COD on 16 Mar 2026; KB Securities calls it an offshore project with 10 offshore turbine towers installed. So the record is REE’s Duyen Hai (V1-4), fully operating in 2026, offshore (intertidal) per the broker report. The Saigon Times says 8 × 6 MW, which conflicts with the 10 turbines of Nhan Dan and KBS, so no turbine field. No citable coordinates (Overpass unreachable); keep GEM’s approximate point. Also: GEM’s “Dong Hai V1-4 Offshore wind farm” (50 MW, announced) has the Vietnamese name “Đông Hải 1 Giai đoạn 4”, matching the 50 MW Dong Hai 1 phase 4 in Ca Mau (Mien Tay Wind Power JSC, launched Aug 2026), not REE’s plant; its point lies off Tra Vinh (from a 4C entry we cannot cite) and is worth a separate check.
why: Type rests on broker reports (KBSV, elibook), not an official source; turbine count/model unresolved; no citable coordinates.

why: No source names the 15 commercial farms or the two partial ones; Thanh Hai 3–4 models not found.

item: 4. Soc Trang 1 Phase 1 (Cong Ly) — did the last 3 MW reach COD?
note_zh: 沒有找到最後 3 MW 通過 COD 的公告。母公司 Super Energy（SUPER）執行長在 2026-07-21（WealthyThai）與 2026-08-17（InfoQuest）仍說越南兩座風場「Soc Trang 30 MW 與 Bac Lieu 99 MW 預定 2026 年 8–9 月陸續 COD／準備 COD」，可見到 2026 年 8 月朔莊一期仍未全部完成（2025-12-31 只有 27 MW，The Investor）。維持興建中、預計 2026。
note_en: No announcement that the last 3 MW reached COD. Super Energy’s CEO said on 21 Jul 2026 (WealthyThai) and 17 Aug 2026 (InfoQuest) that the two Vietnamese farms, Soc Trang 30 MW and Bac Lieu 99 MW, were due to reach COD gradually in Aug–Sep 2026 / were preparing for COD, so Soc Trang phase 1 was still not fully complete in Aug 2026 (only 27 MW from 31 Dec 2025, The Investor). Keep under construction, expected 2026.
why: No full-COD statement through mid-Aug 2026; SET filings not reachable directly.

note_zh: Song An 確實已商轉，但年份只能夾在 2023-11-10（仍未送件）與 2024-05-23（已全廠 COD）之間：2024-05 時累計只有約 1,300 萬 kWh，看似 2024 年春，但同表的 Lạc Hòa（30 MW，業主公告 2023-12-30 COD）累計也只有 1,150 萬 kWh，所以 2023 年 12 月也可能，不能推定。紀錄已是運轉中，年份要嘛寫「最晚 2024」由主工作階段決定，要嘛維持不詳。另外：Song An 與「Cửu An wind farm」座標相同、容量都是 46.2 MW，但確定是兩座（共用升壓站；EVN 2021 名單有 Cửu An 全廠 COD，Song An 列在轉型期表），建議列 NOT_DUP。Song An 的確切位置沒有可引用的座標。
note_en: Song An is in commercial operation, but its year can only be bracketed between 10 Nov 2023 (still not filed) and 23 May 2024 (full COD): by May 2024 it had only about 13 million kWh, which looks like spring 2024, but Lac Hoa (30 MW, which its owner says reached COD on 30 Dec 2023) had only 11.5 million kWh in the same table, so Dec 2023 is also possible and cannot be ruled out. The record is already operating; the main session can either write “2024 at the latest” or keep the year unknown. Also: Song An and “Cửu An wind farm” share coordinates and 46.2 MW, but they are two farms (shared substation; EVN’s 2021 list has Cuu An at full COD while Song An is on the transitional tracker) — add NOT_DUP. No citable coordinates for Song An.
why: Exact COD date not found (EVN trackers Dec 2023–Apr 2024 not located; nhadautu.vn 403).

item: 7. Bac Lieu Phase 3 (141 MW) — status after the Q2 2026 target
note_zh: 仍未商轉。業主母公司 Super Energy 2026-05 說薄寮「第一階段 99 MW」預計 2026 年第 2 季 COD，2026-07-21 改說 8–9 月陸續 COD，2026-08-17 仍是「即將 COD」；越南方面也沒有全場送電或 COD 的報導（2026-03 為 47 部中 33 部完成）。全場 141 MW 中先 COD 的只會是 99 MW，維持興建中、預計 2026。
note_en: Still not in commercial operation. Only 99 of the 141 MW would come first; keep under construction, expected 2026.

note_zh: Lạc Hòa 2 不是缺漏：GEM「Lạc Hòa wind farm」的別名就是「Lac Hoa 2 Wind Power Plant (Phase 2), Lac Hoa Soc Trang Wind Farm (Phase 1)」，二期 124 MW＝Lạc Hòa 2（130 MW 中 123.6 MW、38／40 部在 2023-08 COD；2025-04 仍只有 123.6 MW）。一期 30 MW＝UPC／AC Energy 的 Lạc Hòa（Phong Điện Lạc Hòa 公司，和東社第 20 號場址），業主網站寫 2023-12-30 商轉（EVN 2023-11 表仍未送件、2024-05 表已 COD，吻合），所以 GEM 的 2025 不對，全筆 2023。另一個發現：TDC（永州再生能源公司）的「5 號風場／Lạc Hòa 1」（樂和社與第 2 坊海岸灘地，30 MW，2021-10 只有 25 MW 通過 COD，2022-04 落成；其餘 5 MW 到 2025-04 仍未送件）在資料裡似乎沒有紀錄，見 8a-2。附帶：GEM「Hòa Đông wind farm」（30 MW、2022）在 EVN 表上 2023-11 仍未送件、2024-05 已 COD，2022 年可能不對（未深查）。
note_en: Lac Hoa 2 is not missing: GEM’s “Lạc Hòa wind farm” lists the other names “Lac Hoa 2 Wind Power Plant (Phase 2), Lac Hoa Soc Trang Wind Farm (Phase 1)”; phase 2 (124 MW) = Lac Hoa 2 (123.6 of 130 MW, 38/40 turbines, at COD in Aug 2023; still 123.6 MW in Apr 2025). Phase 1 (30 MW) = UPC / AC Energy’s Lac Hoa (Wind Power Lac Hoa Co, position 20 in Hoa Dong commune), whose site gives COD on 30 Dec 2023 (EVN: not filed in Nov 2023, at COD by May 2024 — consistent), so GEM’s 2025 is wrong and the whole record dates from 2023. Another finding: TDC’s (Vinh Chau Renewable Energy JSC) “wind farm No. 5 / Lac Hoa 1” (coastal flats of Lac Hoa commune and ward 2, 30 MW, only 25 MW at COD in Oct 2021, inaugurated Apr 2022; the remaining 5 MW still not filed in Apr 2025) seems to have no record — see 8a-2. Side note: GEM’s “Hòa Đông wind farm” (30 MW, 2022) was still not filed in EVN’s Nov 2023 table and at COD by May 2024, so its 2022 may be wrong (not researched further).

note_zh: TDC 的 5 號風場（Lạc Hòa 1）與 UPC／AC Energy 的 Lạc Hòa（和東社）是不同業主、不同地點的兩座；資料裡越南的紀錄沒有一筆對應 TDC 這座（GEM 的 Lạc Hòa 一期引用的是 UPC／AC Energy 的網站）。它 2021 年只有 25／30 MW 通過 COD，其餘 5 MW 到 2025-04 仍未送件，照本站「全部完成才算運轉」的規則，加進來時應列興建中或以 25 MW 運轉另註，由主工作階段決定。沒有可引用的座標。
note_en: TDC’s wind farm No. 5 (Lac Hoa 1) and UPC / AC Energy’s Lac Hoa (Hoa Dong commune) are two plants with different owners and sites; no Vietnamese record covers TDC’s (GEM’s Lac Hoa phase 1 cites the UPC / AC Energy site). Only 25 of its 30 MW reached COD in 2021 and the other 5 MW was still not filed in Apr 2025, so under the site’s full-completion rule it would enter as under construction, or as 25 MW operating with a note; the main session decides. No citable coordinates.

item: 8b. Chơ Long (Gia Lai) — is the 105.5 MW built?
proposal:
fix('VNM', 'Chơ Long wind farm · 2', G, '朱龍（Chơ Long）風電廠共 155 MW（Phong Điện Chơ Long 股份公司，原 Krông Chro 縣）：2021 年已建成，但只有 49.5 MW 在 FIT 期限前通過 COD；其餘 105.5 MW 因電能品質（諧波）試驗問題，到 2026-08 仍未商轉（嘉萊省 2026-08-04 向 EVN 陳情）。不是「規劃中」，改為興建中（已建成、未商轉）', 'Cho Long wind plant is 155 MW in all (Cho Long Wind Power JSC, former Krong Chro district): it was built in 2021, but only 49.5 MW reached COD before the FIT deadline; the remaining 105.5 MW was still not in commercial operation in Aug 2026 because of power-quality (harmonics) test issues (Gia Lai’s request to EVN on 4 Aug 2026). Not “pre-construction”: set to under construction (built, not commissioned)', 'https://www.tinnhanhchungkhoan.vn/gia-lai-tiep-tuc-kien-nghi-go-vuong-2-du-an-dien-gio-chua-van-hanh-thuong-mai-post395316.html', st=1, owner='Cho Long Wind Power JSC (Phong Dien Cho Long)', note=True)
fix('VNM', 'Chơ Long wind farm', G, '朱龍風電廠的 49.5 MW 在 2021-10-31 前通過 COD（EVN 名單「部分」，全廠 155 MW）', 'The 49.5 MW part of Cho Long reached COD by 31 Oct 2021 (EVN list, “partial” of the 155 MW plant)', 'https://evn.com.vn/userfile/User/tcdl/files/Thong-tin-COD-dien-gio-den-het-ngay-31-10-2021_2.pdf', year=2021, owner='Cho Long Wind Power JSC (Phong Dien Cho Long)')
note_zh: 105.5 MW 已建成（2021 年完工）但沒有商轉：嘉萊省工貿廳說朱龍與 Yang Trung 兩座 2021 年完工至今未商轉，朱龍的試驗已做完但諧波超標未解決，省長 2026-08-04 請 EVN 想辦法讓「剩下的 105.5 MW」商轉；EVN 2025-04 表也是「未送 COD 文件」。所以 GEM 二期不是「規劃中」，改興建中並加註。一期 49.5 MW：EVN 2021 名單「朱龍 49.50 部分」，年份補 2021。
note_en: The 105.5 MW was built (completed 2021) but is not in commercial operation: Gia Lai’s trade department says Cho Long and Yang Trung were finished in 2021 and still not commercial; Cho Long’s tests are done but the voltage harmonics exceed the limit, and on 4 Aug 2026 the provincial chairman asked EVN to bring “the remaining 105.5 MW” into commercial operation; EVN’s Apr 2025 tracker also says “COD dossier not submitted”. So GEM’s phase 2 is not pre-construction: set to under construction with a note. Phase 1 (49.5 MW): EVN’s 2021 list “Cho Long 49.50, partial”; add year 2021.

item: 9. Quoc Vinh Soc Trang (G, 30 MW) vs Soc Trang 7 Phase 1 (C, 30 MW) — duplicate?

fix('VNM', 'Soc Trang 7 Phase 1', C, '7 號風場一期是 7 部 4.2 MW、29.4 MW（EVN 2021 FIT 名單「Số 7 Sóc Trăng 29,40 全部」），業主朔莊能源股份公司與春求公司', 'Wind farm No. 7 phase 1 has 7 × 4.2 MW, 29.4 MW (EVN’s 2021 FIT list: “Số 7 Sóc Trăng 29,40, full”), owned by Soc Trang Energy JSC and Xuan Cau Co Ltd', 'https://vietnamenergy.vn/the-first-wind-power-projects-in-soc-trang-province-have-started-the-power-generation-27557.html', mw=29.4, turbine='7x 4.2 MW', owner='Soc Trang Energy JSC; Xuan Cau Co Ltd')
note_zh: 兩座不同：越南能源雜誌 2021-10 把國榮（6 號）與 7 號分列——國榮在陸上 7.5 ha、6 部，業主朔莊國榮風電公司；7 號在 3,100 ha 海域（兩期合計）、7 部 4.2 MW，業主朔莊能源公司與春求公司，兩場以 110 kV 線相連、共用永州 110 kV 變電站。EVN 2021-10-31 FIT 名單也分列「Số 7 Sóc Trăng 29,40」與「Quốc Vinh Sóc Trăng 30,00」。建議列 NOT_DUP，並把 7 號一期改 29.4 MW、7 部 4.2 MW、業主補朔莊能源公司。國榮的 6 部標成「6x5.3 MW」（32 MW）與 30 MW 不合，所以國榮的機組欄不寫。
note_en: Two different farms: Nang Luong Viet Nam (Oct 2021) lists Quoc Vinh (No. 6) and No. 7 separately — Quoc Vinh on 7.5 ha onshore with 6 turbines, owner Soc Trang Quoc Vinh Wind Power Co; No. 7 on a 3,100 ha sea area (both phases) with 7 × 4.2 MW, owners Soc Trang Energy JSC and Xuan Cau Co, the two linked by a 110 kV line to the Vinh Chau 110 kV substation. EVN’s FIT list of 31 Oct 2021 also has “Số 7 Sóc Trăng 29,40” and “Quốc Vinh Sóc Trăng 30,00” as separate entries. Add NOT_DUP, and correct No. 7 phase 1 to 29.4 MW, 7 × 4.2 MW, with Soc Trang Energy JSC as owner. Quoc Vinh’s 6 turbines are given as “6x5.3 MW” (32 MW), which does not fit 30 MW, so no turbine field for it.
